summary: RETEST of iter-398 name-match amber banner feature after main agent restored /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx (now 3626 lines, no truncation). Bundle loads cleanly, login works, all 6 review scenarios executed end-to-end via Playwright and PASS. Single-match amber banner shows correct patient card (P2 Aug UI Patient · 48 yrs · Male · Reg. No. P2AUG-UI-1 · 1 previous case) with all three action buttons. Autofill handoff copies age/sex/registration number, amber banner disappears and blue existing-patient banner appears in green 'Details auto-filled' state. Per-name cancel memory works — banner does not reappear while the name is unchanged and Registration Number stays empty. Multi-match variant renders 2 rows (AUG-S3-B and AUG-S3-A, both 50 yrs Female, 1 case), tapping a row opens the detail card with autofill / View cases / Change (back) / Cancel; View cases shows tappable case rows with testid name-match-case-<procId>; Change returns to the list. Suppression regression: blue reg banner shown from Registration Number entry suppresses the amber name banner; partial name ('Step3') and unknown full name show no banner. iter-397 blue reg-number banner is unchanged and fully functional (existing-patient-banner + dismiss/autofill/toggle-cases testids present).

issues: Console spam: repeating 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' warning from React Native Web. Cosmetic but drowns real errors during debugging — suggest hunting the stray whitespace/text node.

action_items: OPTIONAL: TextInput data-testid props on login screen (login-email-input, login-password-input) are not being emitted to the DOM. Only login-submit-btn and build-stamp testids are visible in the DOM on /auth/login. This is a RN Web quirk — using both `testID` and `data-testid` on TextInput usually works. Recommend adding `testID` alongside `data-testid` on the two TextInputs at /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx lines 141 and 158, or switching to the `dataSet={{ testid: 'login-email-input' }}` pattern. Not blocking iter-398 but future testers will hit the same 'input[placeholder]' workaround.

OPTIONAL: patient-age-input, patient-sex-* testids on New Case form similarly did not surface a queryable data-testid on the DOM (input_value returned None). Value is correctly populated in the UI (verified by screenshot). Same RN Web TextInput data-testid propagation issue.
critical_code_review_comments: /app/frontend/app/(tabs)/new-procedure.tsx is 3626 lines — monolithic and hard to review. Suggest extracting the name-match / reg-match banner state machine and the FDI section builders into dedicated modules.
RN Web TextInput `data-testid` propagation is inconsistent across the codebase. Establish a shared helper (or dataSet convention) so test automation can rely on testids for inputs, not placeholders.
